posts.title: Welcome to the blog
posts.excerpt: This is a sample post. Edit or delete it from the Content Manager at /admin, then write your first real one.
posts.body:
This is a sample post so the blog isn't empty on first deploy.

To write a real post, go to **/admin**, log in, and edit this entry or add a new one. Each post has a title, a URL slug, a date, a short excerpt for the blog listing page, and a body written in markdown.

Delete this post once you've published something real.
